body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #8, company drawn at random (seed 20261205) from IT / FMCG / Consumer Durables names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.35 (naive base rate 0.83) that: Uttam Sugar FY27 consolidated operating margin (resolver definition) is >= 10.0%. Our reasoning: H1 FY27 4.44%; H2 needs ~15.8% on ~Rs 1,050 cr revenue. H1 FY27 PBT 7.9 vs 21.1 a year ago; H2 must carry the year; H2 FY26 OPM 15.7% and H2 FY25 17.6% were earned at the old SAP and with B-heavy ethanol; H2 FY27 faces a pending 2026-27 SAP increase and the ESY 2026-27 exclusion of B-heavy/syrup ethanol, against a crop recovering from the 2025 floods and higher sugar prices. Naive base: OPM >= 10% in 9 of 10 FYs FY17-26 [SCR] (Laplace 10/12 = 0.83). Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated (revenue - (total expenses - finance costs - D&A)) / revenue, first reported, is >= 10.0% (1 decimal). Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (consolidated) / screener consolidated. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
